data.body:
FOLLOW-UP to the 22:08 correction (orchestrator, 2026-08-19 22:10 UTC) — partially reinstating the
agent's observation, because a later report made a NARROWER claim that checks out.

The SPECIFIC claim is TRUE: run 32306986850's job `classify Verify route from trusted main` was
observed IN_PROGRESS at 22:07:03 and QUEUED again at 22:07:54. That is a real in-progress -> requeue
with no verdict, consistent with runner eviction on that job. Verified by direct observation at both
timestamps, not inferred.

The BROAD claim ("every GitHub Actions run in navapbc/rebar stuck queued for hours", "starvation")
remains FALSE. In the same window the sibling Verified run 32306779189 (created 22:01:04) cleared
six jobs successfully — clear Verified, require resolvable rebar ticket, classify Verify route,
golden-path (clean install), verify-identity (whole-store authorship gate), eval-discipline — and
was still progressing at 22:09:42. Repo-wide: 35 completed / 4 in_progress / 1 queued.

NET: one job on one run got requeued; the pool is healthy and this change has a second Verified run
making normal progress. The right posture is unchanged — WAIT, do not recheck, do not force. If
32306986850 requeues repeatedly, that single run (not the pool) is the thing to report.

Recording this so the ticket carries an accurate picture rather than either extreme: the earlier
"starved for hours" framing would have wrongly excused a real failure, and my flat rejection of it
would have wrongly dismissed a real eviction signal.
